validated_objective: Deliver an executable expert judgment framework that extracts case-based tacit knowledge into reproducible decision patterns and QIF quality intent derivations.
constraints: Do not store vague advice as knowledge.
Do not treat expert authority or activity counts as quality truth.
Do not use the framework for surveillance or blame assignment.
expected_outcomes: A machine-readable sample package and validator for expert judgment patterns.
A human-readable specification that links tacit judgment extraction to QIF quality intent derivation.
